import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
path=os.path.join(base,'task-2c28a252.py')
code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))\n    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] != bg and r + 1 < h:\n                out[r+1][c] = grid[r][c]\n    return out\n'''
open(path,'w').write(code)
grid=[[0]*6 for _ in range(24)]
coords=[(5,3),(6,1),(6,2),(7,0),(7,1),(7,2),(8,2),(8,3),(9,1),(10,0),(10,1),(11,0)]
for r,c in coords:grid[r][c]=6
exec(code)
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
